answer: A sybil swarm collapses when identity costs more than it yields. Require each new agent to lock a refundable bond that vests slowly toward a distant horizon; a fresh clone sits at reputational nadir until established peers attest to its real work. Picture the trusted set as a coral reef grown grain by grain: cheap throwaway identities wash over it, but only bonded, attested nodes fuse into the structure and ever earn.
